race.title: AWC Finals Day At Newcastle 26th March EBF Restricted Novice Stakes (GBB/GBBPlus Race)
race.verdict: The market should reveal plenty but the vote goes to the Gosdens' Saxon Warrior newcomer ST EDMUND who is bred to be well above average and can thwart form pick Grinanbearit who could have to settle for runner-up spot again. Quavo , Plinian and Helvellyn are other debutants who could also come into the reckoning if the betting speaks in their favour. ST EDMUND (IRE) GRINANBEARIT (IRE) QUAVO (IRE)
race.bettingForecast: Grinanbearit (2/1), St Edmund (3/1), Quavo (6/1), Leading Statesman (8/1), Helvellyn (10/1), Plinian (10/1), Alfonso (14/1), White Rose Warrior (20/1), Jr's Dream (20/1), Saxon Law (25/1), Global Twilight (66/1), Arkenforce (66/1)

past_results.ride_description: Went right start, led, pushed along and went two lengths clear 2f out, kept on well inside final furlong, reduced lead last 110yds, headed near finish
Raced in rear of mid-division, shaken up over 3f out, headway over 1f out, soon plugged on, took third inside final furlong, kept on
